text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I am the genius magical girl Sweepy, Sweep 
Tosho!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Got it? I'm gonna become a great witch 
just like Grandma!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So I'm gonna make you work hard as my 
familiar! For starters, go get me some 
snacks!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
